How Auto Quote works

When a new lead arrives from a provider your admin has enabled for Auto Quote, the system automatically sends a price quote (SMS and/or Email) to the customer on your behalf — no manual work. The price is pulled from Central Dispatch and adjusted by your settings.

Turning it on

  • Your admin enables Auto Quote for each lead provider.
  • For each provider you receive leads from, you turn Auto Quote on/off yourself using the switch in the provider list below.
  • "Forced on by admin" means the admin enabled it for everyone on that provider — it's always on and you can't turn it off.
  • If you don't turn it on for a provider (and it isn't forced), no auto quote is sent for that provider's leads.

Price source

The base price comes from Central Dispatch. If your company has CarLink Price enabled, you can instead pick CarLink — the average carrier pay from your own dispatched history. CarLink returns a single average, so the aggregation is fixed to Average when it's selected.

Price aggregation

Central Dispatch returns up to 5 listing prices for the route — this setting chooses which number becomes the quote:

  • Average — The average of those listing prices (sum ÷ count). The default.
  • Max — The highest listing price.
  • Min — The lowest listing price.
  • Mean predicted — Central Dispatch's own average (predicted) price for the route.

Price adjustment

Set per provider in the list below. Adjusts that provider's price by a percentage, from −30% to +30%. Example: +10% on a $1,000 base quotes the customer $1,100. A provider left at 0% quotes the base price unchanged.

From number

The RingCentral number the SMS is sent from. "Auto (default)" lets the system pick your default sending number.

Templates

  • Pick your own SMS and/or Email template (created in the Templates section). The message is filled in with the order details and the price (the [estimated_price] tag).
  • If you don't set your own template, the provider's default template (set by your admin) is used.

When a quote is NOT sent

  • The provider isn't enabled, or you haven't turned it on for that provider.
  • No template (yours or the provider default) is available.
  • Central Dispatch returns no price for the route — to avoid sending a blank price, nothing is sent and the lead waits for manual pricing.
  • The customer has no valid phone (for SMS) or email (for Email).
  • A quote was already sent for that lead.
